C0736.title: E-Commerce Platform Staff Colluded with Criminal Networks to Facilitate 600 Million Yuan in Cross-Border Gambling Fund Transfers
C0736.summary: Starting in April 2019, Yang Bin and other individuals born in the 1990s registered stores on an e-commerce platform and used technical methods to transfer gambling funds for overseas gambling websites.
